entries.note: VoiceOver earcon "GazeEnteredScene": BifrOSt has speech output (springboard/src/shell/accessibility/speech.rs, espeak-ng) but no earcon set; needed for a screen reader that signals focus, boundaries, wrap, links, errors and mouse tracking with sounds

entries.name: HopperScript.ttf
entries.role: Latin text/display font: HopperScript
entries.note: font family HopperScript: decorative or text typeface with no BifrOSt equivalent (library has only Inter, Geist, IBM Plex Sans, Source Sans 3). Low priority; needed only for documents that name it (Pages/TextEdit/Font Book)

entries.name: invisible_glyphs.ttf
entries.role: Fallback or utility font: invisible_glyphs
entries.note: invisible_glyphs: system fallback/utility font (last-resort glyph boxes, invisible glyphs, keyboard glyphs); BifrOSt font fallback (springboard/render/src/fontfallback.rs) has no last-resort glyph font, tofu is drawn by the renderer

entries.name: Glass.aiff
entries.role: Selectable alert sound (Settings > Sound > Alert Sound)
entries.note: BifrOSt has its own synthesised alert set (Bell, Chime, Pulse, Tick); its Chime tone covers this alert's role. The Apple tone itself is not reproduced
